The corpus names a helper for each.

```json
{"facts": {"dedent": "textwrap.dedent", "clean": "inspect.cleandoc"}}
```

`textwrap.dedent(text)` removes any common leading whitespace from every line of `text`. It is meant for triple-quoted strings that are indented in the source. `inspect.cleandoc` is the helper that cleans up docstring indentation. `inspect.getdoc` uses it to clean the docstring it returns, and `ast.get_docstring` calls it when its `clean` argument is true.
